slots.hypothesis: Core D = time centroid of money minus time centroid of |minute return|. It has had 0 E slots before; r2's E core was day_centroid(Amt). Evidence: bare D scores +0.90 (train 0.90 / valid 1.05); head 8's rho with the known family is 0.135, against 0.493 for the level version. Every periphery seen so far smooths or buckets the level of D, and those candidates now hit the 0.7 library ban against heads 8 and 12. The new periphery works along the time axis, so each stock's persistent level of D cancels out. It does three things: (1) event conditioning: mean D on heavy-volume days minus mean D on light-volume days, plus cross_corr of D with abnormal amount (GKM2001, LMSW2002); (2) direction conditioning: D's deviation from its own norm times the sign or size of the day's open-to-close return, plus cross_corr of D with that return (LY2022, CGZ2019); (3) innovation against D's own 60-day norm: z-score, ts_rank, short minus long, and a version ranked within deciles of D's own 60-day median. No convex transforms, no masks, no size or board keys. Out of sample: the timing structure comes from the T+1 rule, the opening and closing auctions and the investor mix, and all three contrasts are bounded and scale-free. 13 seeds.

Tug of war between overnight and intraday returns. ON = log(open / previous close), ID = log(close / open), built from back-adjusted daily open and close prices. Retail orders and overnight news meet in the opening auction; institutions trade more of the continuous session. T+1 makes overnight returns negative on average, more so for retail-heavy, illiquid, high-disagreement names (BZ2020). In China, anomaly profits sit mostly in the overnight segment (LCC2023), and overnight momentum is stronger after negative shocks (GHLX2019). The reward already removes the 20-day return linearly, so what survives is which segment produced the move. Seeds: ON means at 5, 20 and 60 days; ON ranked within deciles of the same-window total return; LPS2019-style rank difference between the two segments; sign count; ON t-stat; downside-only ON ranked within volatility deciles; cross_corr(ON, ID, 60) as per-stock tug intensity; overnight share of absolute price movement, raw and ranked within volatility deciles; the rank difference ranked within liquidity deciles. No head uses this input or mechanism, so rho with heads should be below 0.3, and no minute-level microstructure quantity is used. 14 seeds.
